The main takeaway from our work is that
the Mini-FLARE imaging system can be used to detect SLNs with NIR fluorescent tracers and is suitable for clinical translation.
a portable, real-time NIR fluorescence imaging system can be easily integrated into the standard of care for SLN mapping.
NIR fluorescence imaging can be used in breast cancer to map SLNs with a clinically acceptable dose of a safe tracer.
